rights_review: Original NOAA Coast Survey documentation and BAG producer NOAA NOS OCS verified. U.S.-government/public-domain Coast Survey acquisition.
lineage: All four bands are the same August 29–September 5, 2008 H11953 acquisition, not independent evidence. Family links do not mean finer bands were resampled from coarser ones.
full_valid_footprint_check: Original full-grid counts match all reviewed-window counts: 1m 6417802, 2m 6281842, 4m 4666652, 8m 307433. Original depths for all bands are below 300 feet. Bounding boxes are not full coverage.

shallow_native_inspection.notice: Valid-data bbox, not full coverage. Original producer interpolation mask unknown.

interpretation: Adding native 1m depth and complete band windows recalculates existing pixel-weighted reach-relative roughness thresholds. Screened area and polygon counts shrink; this is not asserted to prove improved biological accuracy. Source terrain remains processed at its own native spacing. Relative thresholds are a heuristic, not calibrated habitat/catch probability; mixed-resolution weighting remains a methodological limitation for future versioned science review. No thresholds changed to maximize output count.
scope_gap: Does not fill northern Arguello r05 or claim the complete coast. Unknown interpolation masks/substrate and nominal original MLLW depths retained.
publication: Local result; current-head CI and production byte verification required.
